query: I have a 70-year-old female to evaluate. Among female Medicare patients aged 65–75 admitted as transfers from another hospital with a principal diagnosis of heart failure, how many index admissions meet these criteria in the cohort during the study period?
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS num_admissions FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN transfers t ON a.subject_id = t.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 70 AND p.insurance = 'Medicare' AND p.anchor_year BETWEEN 65 AND 75 AND t.eventtype = 'T' AND d.icd_code = '4160' AND a.admittime >= '2015-01-01' AND a.dischtime <= '2020-12-31' AND a.hadm_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM admissions WHERE hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM labevents WHERE itemid = 1017));
